name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
January 8, 2008
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Manager's Conference Room, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
Recommended Action:
ADJOURN TO CLOSED SESSION*3
CS1.
Conference with legal counsel concerning existing litigation, pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9 (a) on the matter of Complaint for Administrative Civil Liability against the Cities of Vista and Carlsbad for Violation of No. R9-2006-0003-DWQ Statewide General Waste Discharge Requirements for Sanitary Sewer Systems, Case Number R9-2007-0099, California Regional Water Quality Control Board, San Diego Region venue. (CC)
CS2.
Conference with legal counsel concerning anticipated litigation, pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9 (b), facts and circumstances that might result in litigation and are known to plaintiffs: Potential claims by the U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service and the California Department of Fish and Game in connection with the Complaint for Administrative Civil Liability against the Cities of Vista and Carlsbad for Violation of No. R9-2006-0003-DWQ Statewide General Waste Discharge Requirements for Sanitary Sewer Systems filed by the California Regional Water Quality Control Board, San Diego Region. (CC)
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Sister Maureen Brown, Pastoral Associate, Church of Saint Thomas More
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation to representatives of New Tang Dynasty Television in recognition of its 2008 Chinese New Year Spectacular. (CC)
P2.
Presentation to the winners of the Public Arts Commission's photography contest. (CC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Ordinances on Agenda (CC)
C3.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C4.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending October 31, 2007 (CC)
C5.
Second Reading of Ordinances (CC)
1.
City Council Ordinance No. 2008-1, entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending the Current Salary Compensation to be Paid to the Mayor and Members of the City Council"; (recommended action continued on following page)
2.
City Council Ordinance No. 2008-2, entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Enacting Chapter 19.20 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding Street Trees, Shrubs and Plants"; and
3.
City Council Ordinance No. 2008-3, entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Approving a Zone Change from Commercial (C-1) to Multi-Residential (R-M (15)) and Approving a Specific Plan Amendment to Remove the Green Oak Villas Project Area from Specific Plan 21 on Eight Acres at 1046 Sycamore Avenue."
C6.
Acceptance of Offer of Dedication for Portion of Watson Way (CC)
C7.
Notice of Completion and Change Order No. 3 for the Olive Avenue Street Improvements Project (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving Change Order No. 3; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , accepting the work as complete, approving the Notice of Completion, and directing the City Clerk to file the Notice of Completion with the County of San Diego Recorder's Office.
C8.
Fiscal Year 2007 State Homeland Security Grant Program (CC)
C9.
Caltrans Transportation Planning Grant Application (CDC)
C10.
Grapevine Road/W. Vista Way Signal Project and Emerald Drive/W. Vista Way Intersection Improvement Project (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , amending the Capital Improvement Program Budget for Fiscal Year 2007/2008;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , rejecting the Palomar Grading & Paving bid as non-responsive, and awarding the Grapevine Road/W. Vista Way Signal Project and Emerald Drive/W. Vista Way Intersection Improvement Project construction agreement to Hillcrest Contracting, Inc., in the amount of $712,180.30, and authorizing the Mayor to execute the agreement;
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving Amendment No. 3 to the agreement with Dokken Engineering, in the amount of $30,000, for design support services for the Emerald Drive/W. Vista Way Intersection Improvement Project, and authoring the Mayor to execute the amendment; and
4.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving Amendment No. 3 to the agreement with Dokken Engineering, in the amount of $20,000, for design support services for the Grapevine Road/W. Vista Way Signal Project, and authorizing the Mayor to execute the agreement.
C11.
West Vista Way Design Grant Time Extension Request (CC)
ITEMS REMOVED FROM CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
Community Service Fees (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving the 2008 Wave Waterpark Fee Schedule;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving the Parks and Community Services recreation fees;
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving the 2008/20098 Moonlight Summer and Winter Season ticket prices; and
4.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving the Out and About Participant Rider Fee.
PUBLIC HEARINGS - WILL BEGIN AT OR AFTER 6:00 P.M.
PH1.
Sewer Service Rates for FY 2008/2009 - FY 2012/2013 (CC/BSD)
1.
Adopt City Council Urgency Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Urgency Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Establishing Rates for Sewer Service Charges for the Vista Sewer System";
2.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Urgency Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled " An Urgency Ordinance of the Buena Sanitation District Establishing Rates for Sewer Service Charges for the Buena Sewer System;
3.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Establishing Rates for Sewer Service Charges for the Vista Sewer System";
4.
Introduce Buena Sanitation District Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled " An Ordinance of the Buena Sanitation District Establishing Rates for Sewer Service Charges for the Buena Sewer System";
5.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Section 14.01.060D of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding Funding of Lifeline Allowance"; (recommended action continued on following page)
(recommended action continued from previous page)
6.
Introduce Buena Sanitation District Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Buena Sanitation District Amending Section 1.060D of the Buena Sanitation District Code Regarding Funding of Lifeline Allowance"; and
7.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , amending the Sewer Rate Study contract with Red Oak Consulting (if the City Council adopts a flow-based rate structure).
PH2.
Vista Grande General Plan Amendment and Rezone - Peter Pozzuoli, Applicant (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving the Negative Declaration;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving a General Plan Amendment to change the land use designation on a portion of the site from Commercial Neighborhood (CN) to Low Density Residential (LD);
3.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Changing the Zoning from Commercial (C-1) to Estate Residential (E-1) on a Portion of the Site and from Agricultural (A-1) to E-1 on a Portion of the Site at 2375 Vista Grande Drive"; and
4.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving a Boundary Adjustment on a 7.9 acre site at 2375 Vista Grande Drive.
PH3.
S. Melrose Drive Medical Office Building - Franz Vista Melrose LLC, Applicant (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving the Mitigated Negative Declaration;
2.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending the Vista Business Park Specific Plan to Incorporate New Parking Standards for Medical Office Uses and Change the Land Use Designation from Use Area "B" to Use Area "J" on 4.52 Acres at 2643 S. Melrose Drive"; and (recommended action continued on following page)
(recommended action continued from previous page)
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving a Site Development Plan and Tentative Parcel Map for a 40,250 square foot medical office building, parking, landscaping, and associated site improvements on 4.52 acres at 2643 S. Melrose Drive.
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies
ADJOURNMENT
